summary: Even near an exact four-projective-direction rank-three endpoint, operator/frame-norm closeness does not give a support-free o(1) comparison of unit-slab volumes. An explicit target-normalized five-coordinate rotation A_theta->A0 and single-interval product supports with fifth interval translated by 11/sin(theta) give a same-slab volume gap at least 1/109. This is not a QFORM counterexample: the family has at most five row directions and is uniformly bounded by the completed finite-direction theorem. The stability collar must be affine-uniform/nonperturbative and preserve product provenance.
